# Changelog

All notable changes to LibreIndex are documented here.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-09-23

- Added a three-line folder-to-answer Python API.
- Added PDF, Markdown, text, CSV, and JSON readers.
- Added local Ollama embeddings and answer generation.
- Added persistent embedded LanceDB vector search.
- Added citations, excerpts, retrieval confidence, and low-confidence warnings.
- Added explicit re-indexing, CLI commands, tests, and cross-platform CI.
